newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-DAVIES READY AND WILLING FOR LIONS TOUR.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DAVIES READY AND WILLING FOR LIONS TOUR.

text.p: Veteran Welsh fly-half Johnathan Davies said on Wednesday he was available for the British Lions tour of South Africa and insisted he was still fit enough to perform at the highest level.
The 34-year-old was not included in the preliminary squad announced by Lions manager Fran Cotton last month.
But after a brilliant performance against England at the weekend, Cotton has indicated Davies could still make the final 35-man party to tour South Africa from May to July.
And Davies, who said last Saturday's match would be his last for Wales, insisted he was still good enough to play for the British side.
"I played in the international last Saturday and I've been playing in the European Cup and the first division with Cardiff and my fitness levels are still high," he said.
"My pace isn't as good as what it was but my distribution and my brain are still in good working order -- as long as I don't take too many hits in the remains of the season.
"It'll be very difficult experience in South Africa but it'll be a fantastic experience and my body's okay for it."
The final Lions squad will be named on April 2.
